Owing to the Surrey Relays on the same day we were short of sprinters for this meeting. Our 4 x 110 team consisted of Underwood, Holtum, Bartlett and Mullen, while our 4 x 440 team was Kennedy, Alan Bishop, Ken.
The Club has met with successes in many open meetings and our team of Walker, Sexton, Beaumont and Underwood won the Mile Medley Relay at the Charlotteville meeting on Whit-Monday.

The last event was a four-lap relay race and our team of Underwood, Odde, Heathfield and Picton put up a fine show to win in 2 min. 44.8 secs., which was only a couple of seconds outside the ground record.
Odde second and Tom Underwood third.
